request.requirement: Repair the existing SF16 FixedAssembly model using the selected checker evidence. Preserve the modern matte-black bookcase, both full-height side panels, three usable shelves, and the visibly slanted upper back panel. Preserve all six separate print parts and all five existing physical interfaces; do not globally fuse parts or delete features to pass. Keep root_part, mm_per_unit=1, final_size_mm=[1125,450,1800], and fit_offset_mm=0.2 frozen. Make the smallest coordinated source correction supported by actual geometry evidence; maintain mate frames and check any related interfaces after changing bodies or placement. Only assembly_topology is selected. Standing, FEA and overhang are not evaluated in this run. This is an existing-source repair, with one initial evaluation and at most two cumulative source repairs (this continuation authorizes exactly one additional repair) followed by re-export and re-evaluation. Do not regenerate or re-plan the object. If no reasonable repair exists, report NO_CHANGE.

context_policy.coder_initial: isolated requirement, plan, and references; source.py is written by tool
context_policy.coder_repair: isolated per repair with plan and current feedback; source.py is read and patched by tool
context_policy.debugger: isolated per execution failure with current error; source.py is read by tool
context_policy.image_critic: isolated per round with current renders, references, and explicit text-only prior judgements
context_policy.code_critic: isolated per round with current renders and explicit critic history; source.py is read by tool
context_policy.engineering_critic: isolated per round with current renders, structured checker evidence, and source.py read by tool
